name: What the Moon Keeps
summary: The moon keeps what the dead lose. Four small things of ours lie in its pockets, one from each part of our journey.

stages.journal: The Vagrant says the moon keeps four small things of ours, one from each part of the journey: his platform, the farmland, Maidenmist, and the burning hill.
stages.hint: Search the Round's platform, the farmland, the Maidenmist barrow and Rowan's Rise.

stages.journal: We gave the four keepsakes to the Vagrant to carry. He will keep them safe in the baggage car.
We kept the four keepsakes close. Things want to be near their people.
We left the keepsakes to the moon. It will probably look after them better than most.
